compatibility: Unknown contract versions are preserved and explicitly mapped in separate assessments; never silently upgraded.

guardian.limitations: No assertion of truth, authenticated publisher, arbitrary personal/business safety or consumer acceptance.
guardian.meaning: Contract validity only; maintainer acceptance required. No submitted code execution.

questions.context: Which consumer, Program Kit/profile/knowledge versions, phase, task and triggering command? What source and dirty-state limits were observed?
questions.decision: What recorded decision explanation, constraints and considered alternatives explain the reported local choice? Mark later explanations retrospective; absent explanations unknown.
questions.expectation: What was expected and which exact requirement, guidance, task or tool contract supports it? Explicitly identify unsupported expectations.
questions.lesson: What upstream lesson is proposed, if any? Do not present a hypothesis, local remedy or domain adaptation as an established defect or accepted architecture.
questions.observation: What happened, under which triggers, with which observable consequences and available reproduction or counterexample?
questions.remedy: What local change or workaround was made, what did it preserve or bypass, and what was its scope?
questions.resources: Which knowledge, tools and skills were available, and which were actually consulted according to retained evidence? Availability is not use.
questions.results: What results, failures, uncertainty and remaining blockade are evidenced? Distinguish reported tests, inspected tests and independently executed proof.

vocabulary.assessment: Independent versioned evaluation; never a rewrite of the consumer account.
vocabulary.independently-reproduced: The attributed result was independently executed under stated conditions.
vocabulary.inspected: Retained evidence was directly inspected; this is not independent execution.
vocabulary.recorded: Decision explanation retained from the original work.
vocabulary.repair: Owner-selected shared change; several consumer requests may support one repair.
vocabulary.reported: A source says an action/result happened; evaluator has not inspected its proof.
vocabulary.request: Stable consumer observation identity; distinct from repair/finding identity.
vocabulary.retrospective: Later explanation; not an original reasoning trace.
vocabulary.revision: Immutable evidence account superseding an exact earlier request hash.
vocabulary.unclassified: Original wording retained without forcing unknown concepts into canonical categories.
vocabulary.unknown: Evidence does not establish this fact; do not fabricate it.
